best_for: Streamers, video editors and office workers who own a Stream Deck and want to map apps, hotkeys and scenes to its keys and dials.

points.title: It drives the hardware
points.text: This is the free app that sets up what each Stream Deck key, dial and pedal does. Without an Elgato device, or a Stream Deck Mobile Pro license on your phone, there is little to do with it.

points.title: A virtual deck on screen
points.text: Since version 7.0, Virtual Stream Deck puts panels of up to 64 keys on your desktop. It works if you own a supported Stream Deck, have Stream Deck Mobile with Pro, or own certain Corsair gear. The device must have been connected within the last 30 days. It needs Windows 11 or macOS 13 Ventura or later.

points.title: Plugins do the heavy lifting
points.text: Actions for other apps come as plugins. Version 7.6 rebuilt the Spotify plugin, whose new actions need a Spotify Premium account, and added a plugin for the ChatGPT desktop app. Stream Deck Neo gained an infobar for live data such as CPU load and weather.

points.title: Hotkeys now reach admin apps
points.text: Version 7.6.1 reworked hotkeys on Windows so they work in apps running as administrator and in many fullscreen games. It also fixed several crashes and patched third-party components.

points.title: Versions on this page
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 50 versions of the x64 installer, which installs for all users, so rolling back after a bad update is easy there. The Mac build is one universal installer, and only the current release is listed.
